newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NOTIONNEL TO HOVER AROUND 129.30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NOTIONNEL TO HOVER AROUND 129.30.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF will oscillate around 129.30 on Friday, ahead of move lower, technical analysts said.
Howard Friend, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, said if the contract managed to break through Thursday's high at 129.56, there may be scope for it to climb to 129.94.
"I expect choppy action around 129.30 for the next day or two," he said. "The market is unwinding its decline from 131.14, the lower top made on July 31."
By 0737 GMT, September notionnel futures were down six basis points at 129.28.
To the downside, Friend put support at the low reached on August 6 at 128.96. "I think the contract is marking time before it goes down to the low 128s," he said.
"But we had a bit of a dip this morning and it didn't like it down there, so perhaps we can probe up to the high 129s later today, but at the end of the day it won't be sustained."
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said the contract was set for a short-term range of 129.08 to 129.54.
"Corrective gains might be resumed for the short-term to 129.92 retracement, but appears limited to 130.34 trend resistance," they said in a research note.
They said for a neutral to positive tone to emerge in the futures, they must recover above 131.04, a trendline drawn from the July 23 high at 131.24 and the July 31 high at 131.14.
But with range-trading the order of the day, Deutsche analysts said that level, and the 130.34 resistance, were expected to remain unscathed.

"After a short period of consolidation, a resumption of declines is favoured," they said. "A confirmed break below 129.10 will signal the recent uptrend completed and targets deeper retracements, initially to the 128.66 area."
By 0754 GMT, September Pibor was up 0.04 at 96.48.
